notes.title: Warawara Invaders: v1.0.7.1 update
notes.notes:
To avoid errors that may occur the first time you start the app, 
I have included a default configuration file that allows you to manually place the originally automatically generated files.
Note: Ignore this file if you can run correctly, as it is not necessary.

Steps:
--------------------------------------------------
ERROR in
action number 1
of Create Event
for object obj_InitMgr:
--------------------------------------------------
Copy the included files into place only if the above error occurs at game launch.
(Note: If the game is working properly, do not perform the following steps. 
The local data will be initialized.)

Describe how to access the location where the file is located.
Open the Steam client, look for this game in the list of game titles on the left of the "Library" screen, 
right-click and select "Properties" to open it.

In the "Local Files" tab of the properties, 
click "Browse Local Files" to open the folder where the game is installed on your PC.

Check if there is a "default_setting_files" folder in the folder.
If not, please update your game to the latest version.

Open the "default_setting_files" folder, 
follow the instructions in howtouse.txt to copy the files into place, 
and then click Launch the game again.

That's all.
The above steps are also described in the game's Discussions thread.


There is no change to the game content.
Since there are no updates to the application itself, the version remains at v.1.0.7.0.
If there are bugs, please report those.
